result.topic_en: Transformation formulas for the quantities x, s, s' of a minimal surface under the substitution $\eta_1 = (\alpha-\eta)/(1+\alpha'\eta)$ (rotation, including the case $\theta=\pi$), invariance of the integral defining u, and how to express the distance of a surface point from a plane of arbitrary normal direction.
result.transcription:
$(1+\alpha\alpha')x_1 = ([-1+\alpha\alpha'-] 1-\alpha\alpha')x \mp \alpha' s + \alpha^{\mp} s'$
$e^{-\theta i} s_1 ([-1-] 1+\alpha\alpha') = -2\alpha x + s - \alpha^2 s'$
$e^{+\theta i} s_1' (1+\alpha\alpha') = -2\alpha' x \mp \alpha'^2 s + s'$

Diese Formeln gehen für $\theta = \pi$ über in $\eta_1 = \frac{\alpha - \eta}{1+\alpha'\eta}$
$(1+\alpha\alpha')x_1 = (1-\alpha\alpha')x + \alpha' s + \alpha s'$
$(1+\alpha\alpha')s_1 = 2\alpha x - s + \alpha^2 s'$
$(1+\alpha\alpha')s_1' = 2\alpha' x + \alpha'^2 s - s'$

$\int \sqrt{\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial \log \eta_1} i}\, d\log\eta_1 = \int \sqrt{\frac{\partial x}{\partial \log \eta} i}\, d\log\eta = u$

[-Ist-] Wir können zunächst u [-als Function von $\eta$ [?] beliebig [?]-] {+willkürlich [?]+} setzen;
ist u bestimmt, so ergiebt sich
$[-x-] x = -i \int \frac{\partial u}{\partial \log \eta} du + i \int \frac{\partial u'}{\partial \log \eta'} du'$

Um den Abstand des Punktes $\eta$ der Fläche von
irgend einer andern Ebene, welche senkrecht
[-gegen-] {+zur+} Richtung ($\eta = \alpha$) steht, durch $\eta$ u. $\eta'$ zu auszudrücken
erhalten, hat man in diesem Ausdrucke
von x nur $d\log\eta$ durch $d\log\left(\frac{\alpha - \eta}{1+\alpha'\eta}\right)$ zu ersetzen.

methods.what: Transformation of x, s, s' under rotation by angle θ with axis parameter α
Special case θ=π: linear substitution η₁=(α−η)/(1+α'η) and transformed coordinates
Invariance of the integral defining u under the transformation
methods.quote: $\int \sqrt{\frac{\partial x_1}{\partial \log \eta_1} i}\, d\log\eta_1 = \int \sqrt{\frac{\partial x}{\partial \log \eta} i}\, d\log\eta = u$
